boundary.description: From the boundary stone on Shawcliffe Lane SW  along the Ribble Valley / Hyndburn civil boundary, to  York Road,  Rishton Road and N along Hollowhead Lane, crossing Whalley New Road A666 then along  Ribchester Road B6245 and W along River Ribble.
